models.trace: Nearest live Leak Source, ignoring its target-free/graphic-hidden state; exclude same-owner-life reached markers. A separate flying cursor suspends original checkpoints, waits and goal consumption. Source speed/stage scale and fear/attract/control priority remain shared. Search1s with5s no-target fallback; mode entry searches immediately.
models.charge: One source-owned permanent reached marker per accepted contact. Two Charge records commit modes1/2 at original Change OnAttack markers, ignoring silence and granting stun immunity while affecting. Mode Switch restartFSM ends the old cast at commitment; interruption before commitment retains the old mode. The second committed mode resumes the original route without further tracing.
models.blast: ON_OWNER_KILLED and source not silenced emit one static one-second projectile. The retained collider is radius1.25, checks at reach, always reaches at expiry, cannot hit a body twice and does not stop for invalid source. The expiry samples selectable ground bodies with camouflage bypass, uses current same-life source ATK and the committed1/2/3 coefficient, and never emits on leak. Born output holds battle completion and is cancelled only by battle end.
models.limits: Numeric callback/FSM dispatch, nearest-distance tie order, original-route suspension, collider-edge contact, restart timing, static reach-at-expiry and retirement ATK fallback are explicit local mappings. Source object reuse uses its birth ATK rather than borrowing a new deployment. Native compiled/frame parity and visual size/effects remain unclaimed.
